content: When maintenance is ongoing, it'd be nice to have a discord event or announcement using @time timestamps for the update's ETA to minimize people asking when maint is over
based. I imagine we have vast difference in time zones. or at least we could use the unix time function that discord support, like this: <t:1787523360:F> <t:1787523480:R>

Using Unix time code will automatically convert time display to everyones local time.
I suggested this to Goya when she's still here. She adopted it...and now we are doing it again.
